meetings.route: UK visit permission (Common Travel Area); Sark's own rules for any work
meetings.detail: Sark is in the Bailiwick of Guernsey, which uses the UK visit visa and permission for the whole Common Travel Area. The States of Guernsey say no employment activity is allowed under the Standard Visitor route. Guernsey's Population Management Law does not apply in Sark, which has its own local regulations (not read). Check the activity fits the UK visitor permitted activities.
meetings.next: Ask the Sark authorities (Chief Pleas) in writing about any local work rule.

culture-and-protocol.dress_and_conduct: Ask locally. Visit Sark: the island is car-free. Visitors walk, cycle, take a horse-drawn carriage or the tractor bus. Keep left, and don't ride bicycles on footpaths or cliff paths.
culture-and-protocol.note: No official source read; the authority is named so it can be asked.

laws.rule: Only tractors, invalid carriages (mobility scooters), construction vehicles and combine harvesters may be driven on Sark's roads (Motor Vehicles (Sark) Law 2013); there are no cars or taxis. Visitors may apply for a temporary mobility-scooter licence. No motor vehicle may be imported without the Road Traffic Committee's permission.
